The '''Tascollan Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
The Tascollan Nebula was located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> and contained a single [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="LAD">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref>

==History==
During the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the Sith consort [[Valik Kodank]] built a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]], the [[Temple of Pain]], in the nebula and she attempted so use some [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] to move it into the center of a sun there. However, her plan went wrong and the temple was placed inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] instead.<ref name="LAD" />

[[File:Bas-relief_sculpture.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[bas-relief sculpture]] concealed the location of the Tascollan Nebula.<br />The [[Star/Legends|star]] on each of the uniforms depicted the location of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]&mdash;[[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].]]
Later, prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the nebula was used by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]], who left a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-slab containing the frozen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ji-Ad Sarain]] floating within the nebula. Gomalo created a [[bas-relief sculpture]] which marked the location of the carbonite. Sarain was later recovered during the period of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] through the intervention of a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of individuals]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="PRYA">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian}}</ref>

[[Thaum Rystra]] later traveled to the nebula and became the apprentice of Kodank's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]]. He later lured a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operatives there in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="LAD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tascollan Nebula was created for the roleplaying adventure [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']]. It was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to be nebula that appeared in another adventure, ''[[Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian|Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian]]''. [[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]], in his blog post, spelled the nebula as "Tascallon."<ref name="Blog-danwallace|153">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref>
